text:
I need to:
1. Calculate 64! (64 factorial)
2. Convert it to a string to access individual digits
3. Sum all the digits

```python
import json
import math

# Calculate 64!
factorial_64 = math.factorial(64)

# Convert to string to access individual digits
factorial_str = str(factorial_64)

# Sum all the digits
digit_sum = sum(int(digit) for digit in factorial_str)

print(json.dumps({"answer": digit_sum}))
```

The code:
1. Uses `math.factorial(64)` to compute 64!
2. Converts the result to a string so we can iterate through each digit
3. Sums all the digits by converting each character back to an integer and adding them up

Running this gives us the sum of the decimal digits of 64!
